name: sprint18_breakout_altcoins
hypothesis: sprint01's 60-min rolling-high breakout FAILED on BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT; momentum/breakout literature (Liu-Tsyvinski et al.) finds momentum effects concentrate in smaller, less liquid coins where information diffuses slower -- last untested cell in the 5-signal x {majors,alts} coverage matrix.
power_argument: C0/C1 measured dispersion ~33bp std, T2 round-trip cost floor ~26bp -> min detectable edge at n=300,t=2 is ~3.8bp, well below the cost floor. 8 symbols x ~92 validation days x cap8/day = up to 5888 possible entries; sprint04/13/16/17 realized 5803-7269 trades under identical caps/basket, so n>=300 is near-certain.
